rows.text: clears bit 3 of dword `rcx+0x40` when `rcx` is non-null; when byte `+0x3C4` has bit 1, sets bit 6 of `+0x40` and then calls `00241940` + 0x29 when bits 0 and 5 of `+0x40` are both set, otherwise calls the function pointer qword `[rcx]` (when non-null) with `rdx` = `00915058` and then `00241940` + 0x44(`rcx`); afterwards calls `00241940` + 0x55 when dword `+0x3C4` has bit 10 (0x400), and stores 0 to byte `+0x3BC` when byte `+0x3C4` has bit 7

walks the list linked by qword `+0xD70` starting at `rcx` (a null `rcx` returns 0); each node whose word `+0xD54` is 5 is unlinked (when non-null, the next node's qword `+0xD68` takes its `+0xD68`, the previous node's qword `+0xD70` takes its `+0xD70`), gets 0 in word `+0xD54` and in qwords `+0xD70` and `+0xD68`, and is passed to `0028D1C0` + 0x7A; returns the first node from `rcx` onward whose word `+0xD54` was not 5, or null when there is none

returns 0 when qword `0209BE80` is null, when its dword `+0x10F68` has bit 13 (0x2000), or when `0028F5F0` + 0x2A(that object `+0xAB30`) returns 0; otherwise tail-jumps to `0028F5F0` + 0x45 with qword `0209BE80` `+0xAB30` in `rcx`
when qword `0209BE80` is non-null and its qword `+0x10FB8` is 0, stores the result of `00290740` + 0x1A to qword `+0x10FB8` of qword `0209BE80`; otherwise returns without a write

with `p` = qword `0209AC30`, returns when qword `p+0x2C8+ecx*8` is null; otherwise, when `edx` is positive (signed), sets bit 11 and replaces bits 22-31 with the low 10 bits of `dx` in dword `+0x7C` of that object and, when non-null, of qword `p+0x2B8+ecx*8`; then (`p` is re-read from `0209AC30` after each store and call) passes qword `p+0x2C8+ecx*8` to `002C98F0` + 0x75 and qword `p+0x2B8+ecx*8` to `002C98F0` + 0x89, and, when qword `0209C318` is non-null, tail-jumps with it to the same callee at `002C98F0` + 0x9F

takes `r` = `002D54B0` + 0x11(0x14, zero-extended `dx`) and `o` = qword `+8` of qword `rcx+0x60` (`o` stays `rcx` when `rcx` is null), then stores `002D54B0` + 0x2C(qword `r+0x18`, 0) to qword `o+0x18` and `002D54B0` + 0x37(0) to dword `o+0x20`
calls `00309E40` + 0x18 with float `022C2184` in `xmm0` and float `022C2188` minus float `022C2184` in `xmm1`, and stores the float result to `022C2188`

calls `0035C660` + 0x3C with 0x86E when dword `02092730` is 3 and 0x86F otherwise, fills a zeroed 0x30-byte stack block with that result at `+0`, 0 at `+8`, qword `0208EA28` at `+0x10`, `rcx` at `+0x18`, dword 0 at `+0x20`, word 0x102 at `+0x28` and dword 0x4FB at `+0x2C`, and calls `0035C660` + 0x76(0, the block)
when qword `02B47730` is non-null and its byte `+0xC0` has bit 1, calls `003C8950` + 0x19 and then clears bit 1 of dword `+0xC0` of qword `02B47730`; otherwise returns without a call
